{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "short_smiles_high_halogen",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "short_smiles",

          "rationale": "High halogen content can enhance hydration affinity."

      "ucb_weight": 0.6,

      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "hypothesis": "Short molecules with high halogen content may maximize hydration affinity but could fail if halogens decrease affinity."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "mid_smiles_low_branch",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "mid_smiles",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_mid"},
          "weight": -0.5,
          "rationale": "Moderate length molecules balance complexity and affinity."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "low_branch",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_low"},
          "weight": 0.7,
          "rationale": "Low branching can simplify molecular structure, enhancing hydration affinity."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.25,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "hypothesis": "Mid-length molecules with low branching may maximize hydration affinity but could fail if branching is necessary for affinity."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "short_smiles_high_halogen",
  "lesson": "Shorter molecules with high halogen content show potential for maximizing hydration affinity.",
  "revision_summary": "Revised the previous skill by focusing on high halogen content instead of high hetero atoms, and proposed a new skill emphasizing low branching in mid-length molecules."
}
